summary: Registrant DATZ World Holdings Corp., fka LeafBuyer Technologies, filed an 8-K reporting completion of its merger with RagingBull.com, LLC on June 8, 2026. Per the Merger Agreement dated Nov. 10, 2025, acquirer LB Acquisition Corp. merged into RagingBull, which survived as a wholly-owned subsidiary. Consideration was 15,000,000 newly issued common shares, representing ~95% ownership to RagingBull holders post-reverse split. Board and officers were reconstituted, with departures of Kurt Rossner (CEO/Chairman), Mark Breen (CFO), and others. The merger is treated as a tax-free exchange under IRC Sec. 368. Watch for potential OTC pink-sheet volatility and any post-closing adjustments.
